uutiset.t: Odd Lots: GTA VI Is the Most Expensive Game Ever Made. Is It Worth It?
uutiset.s: The much anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI will be released on November 19 as the most expensive video game ever made. Bloomberg News video game reporter Jason Schreier joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway on the Odd Lots podcast to discuss why it took 13 years and reportedly over $1 billion to make

uutiset.t: AI-Driven Firm Corgi Ventures Into Banking After ETFs, Insurance
uutiset.s: Financial technology firm Corgi is looking to add another line of business to its fast-growing portfolio: banking.

uutiset.t: Turkey Slaps Main Erdogan Rival Imamoglu With Political Ban
uutiset.s: A Turkish court ordered a political ban for Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s main opponent, paving the way for the ruling party to take control of Turkey’s largest city.

uutiset.t: Once the Regional Laggard in Sustainable Debt, Mexico Now Leads
uutiset.s: Mexico’s government has issued a record amount of sustainable debt this year, bucking a decline in such sales seen across emerging-markets as local pension funds step up investments.

uutiset.t: CoreWeave Says Nvidia Is ‘Not One Person,’ Remains a Key Partner
uutiset.s: CoreWeave Inc. has moved to dispel concerns that Jensen Huang’s exit from Nvidia Corp. could affect the chipmaker’s support for neoclouds, with strategy leader Ben Richardson saying it plans to keep working with the company.

uutiset.t: JPMorgan Adds Dallas Hub for Private Bank Unit Catering to Funds
uutiset.s: JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s private bank is expanding its Fund Banking Group with a new hub in Dallas in a bid to tap the city’s growing alternative investment scene.

uutiset.t: Waller Thinks Fed Should Consider Half-Point Rate Hike
uutiset.s: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller urged the central bank to consider a larger, half-percentage-point rate hike at its December meeting. Waller said inflation remains headed in the wrong direction in comments Wednesday on CNBC. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloombe

uutiset.t: Alaska’s Oil Renaissance Dawns After Decades of Decline
uutiset.s: State is forecast to add 23,000 barrels a day this year and about double that in 2027.

uutiset.t: Stocks Rise After Nvidia Earnings; Xi Welcomes Trump
uutiset.s: US equity futures rally after Nvidia's outlook boost helped ease investors' concerns over the durability of the AI trade and the chipmaker's confidence to thrive without Jensen Huang. uutiset.t: Stocks Waver After Nvidia Results as Anthropic IPO Test Looms
uutiset.s: US technology stocks edged higher in the wake of Nvidia Corp.’s earnings, while traders looked to the mammoth market debut of Anthropic PBC for the next key test of the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Lithium CEO Warns of Perils Facing US Critical Minerals Push
uutiset.s: Lithium Americas Corp.’s flagship US mine has become an expensive test of the Trump administration’s push to rebuild a domestic critical minerals industry, with labor shortages, rising wages and tariffs pushing its construction bill almost $900 million higher.

uutiset.t: Credit Chiefs Warn of ‘Fear Factor’ as Debt Reprices All at Once
uutiset.s: A sharp repricing across fixed-income markets in recent months is likely to continue as interest rates remain elevated, causing a shakeout among weaker borrowers across industries.

uutiset.t: South African Rand Hits Eight-Month Low on Gold, Fed Hike Bets
uutiset.s: The rand slumped to its weakest level against the dollar since March as a retreat in gold, a key South African export, added to worries that a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike will erode the South African currency’s yield advantage.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Approaches Final IPO Hurdle After Tech Stocks Decline
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC is on the cusp of pricing potentially the biggest IPO of all time, defying days of volatility in technology stocks that threaten to weigh on the startup’s long-awaited debut.

uutiset.t: Bitcoin Erases Bessent Rally as Leverage and Liquidity Fade
uutiset.s: Bitcoin has erased all the gains from its late-summer rally as fading risk appetite and the record hack at exchange Binance drove investors to retreat, leaving the largest token trading in a thinner market increasingly vulnerable to sharp price swings.
